_doc: Stream E (M2). Quests for zone 'brackwater' (Brackwater Fen). Format: data/quests/README.md. Rewards: xp = share of a level's XP at the quest level, gold = multiple of a kill's gold; item.tier rolls at your level. `killRare` {zone, slot} names the zone's rare by slot (data/provinces/rares.json). Story-chain quests carry `story: n` (data/quests/province.json).

reeve_mabry.name: Reeve Mabry Fenwick
reeve_mabry.greeting: Mind the planks. Mind the water. Mind everything, really.

eel_woman_wenna.name: Wenna Eelwife
eel_woman_wenna.greeting: Eels. Want some? No? More for me.

tower_keeper_hob.name: Keeper Haskel
tower_keeper_hob.greeting: Reedwall Tower: the only dry spot for a mile, and it's damp.

witch_mabry.name: Old Mabry
witch_mabry.greeting: My jars are open and my slimes are loose. Help a poor old woman, dear, it's slightly your fault for existing.

quests.name: Eels and Omens
quests.offer: Copperdell's foreman says you're handy. Serpents in the reeds have been taking our nets and our nerve. Take theirs instead.
quests.done: Keeper Haskel says the omens point west, to Wychwood. Omens always point somewhere damp.

quests.name: Back in the Jar
quests.offer: My slimes have escaped, dear. Squash them. Gently, they're expensive. No — squash them hard, they bite.
quests.done: Lovely. I'll keep the lid on next time. I said that last time too.

quests.name: The Frog Chorus
quests.offer: The croakers sing all night and eat the eels all day. I'd like one of those things to stop.
quests.done: Quiet! I can hear the eels thinking now.

quests.name: Lights in the Fen
quests.offer: Wisps lure folk off the planks. Bring me their glow and I'll put it in the tower lamp where it can't hurt anyone.
quests.done: There. Brightest lamp in the fen. Mildly haunted.

quests.name: The Drowned Steps
quests.offer: There's a temple under the fen. The steps come up at low water. Something down there rings a bell when the tide's out.
quests.done: No bell. No omens. Just eels. Bliss.

quests.name: The Fen's Old Terror
quests.offer: There's one in the fen my gran warned me about. My gran was usually right. Kill it before she's right again.
quests.done: Gran would be proud. Gran would also say 'about time'.
